quarterly_data.signal: NVIDIA's CFO commentary for the second quarter of fiscal 2027: NVIDIA partnered with its suppliers to secure the critical components needed to meet demand for the next several years, and its supply and capacity commitments increased from $119 billion last quarter to $279 billion as of July 26, 2026, primarily related to the procurement of memory. By fiscal year the supply and capacity commitments are $92 billion for the remainder of fiscal 2027, $87 billion for 2028 and $88 billion for 2029. The same commitments table lists capital expenditures commitments of $8 billion.

quarterly_data.signal: NVIDIA's Q2 fiscal 2027 CFO commentary: NVIDIA has partnered with leading AI clouds to broaden access to its AI infrastructure, earning revenue on the upfront sale of its infrastructure and, if certain criteria are met, a share of the revenue the AI clouds generate from third-party customers. As of July 26, 2026 its AI cloud agreements commitments were $36 billion and data center leases not commenced for third parties $20 billion; those lease agreements have terms of approximately fifteen years, are expected to commence between fiscal year 2028 and fiscal year 2029, and NVIDIA expects to reassign them to third parties.
